datasets.name: scam-ham-india-14-languages
datasets.notes: 14-language balanced Indian dataset covering Bengali, Hindi (Devanagari), Hinglish, English and regional scripts. 1,000 rows per language (500 scam, 500 ham).

datasets.name: indian-scam-sms-synthetic-audited
datasets.notes: Synthetic audited hard-negatives corpus imitating Indian bank, utility, KYC, and job scams and their genuine look-alikes. Used for training augmentation (<30% cap).

datasets.name: scamshield-corpus
datasets.notes: Large-scale multilingual smishing and social engineering corpus. Features annotated Indian English and Hindi scam patterns with intent heads.

datasets.name: scam-ham-india-anmol
datasets.notes: Indian English SMS collection focusing on Aadhaar/KYC phishing, telecom promotions, lottery, UPI fraud, and job scams.

datasets.name: india-spam-sms-junioralive
datasets.notes: Indian Telecom SMS Spam Collection containing binary spam and ham messages from Indian mobile networks.

datasets.name: cloveai-india-spam-sms
datasets.notes: Large Indian English SMS dataset. Label 0 is clean transactional/service/personal ham. Label 1 mixes commercial promotions (Myntra etc.) with potential scams, flagged ambiguous.

datasets.name: bengali-sms-smishing-dataset
datasets.notes: 7,005 Bengali and Banglish SMS messages. Originated from Bangladesh context (+880, local banks), marked diagnostic for language representation and cross-border robustness.

datasets.name: trilingual-fraud-consumer-protection-v2
datasets.notes: Frozen 159-row external challenge dataset by Karan Verma. Held out as development challenge only; never used for fitting or threshold selection.

datasets.name: karanverma19-indian-multilingual-scam-120
datasets.notes: Previously inspected HF-120 Indian multilingual benchmark. Kept as dev/diagnostic only, per rule 1.2.

datasets.name: ysangam-indian-cyber-scam-phonecall
datasets.notes: Excluded per rule 1.2b: conversational phone call audio transcripts rather than SMS message payloads.
